title: Manistique City Hall closes due to worsening weather conditions
text:
Manistique | wikipedia.org
Manistique | wikipedia.org
City Hall in Manistique is closed on Tuesday, February 18, 2026, because of severe weather conditions. The city has announced that road conditions are currently poor and are expected to worsen as the day progresses. Residents are advised to remain at home if possible.
The city stated, "City Hall is closed today, Tuesday, February 18, 2026 due to inclement weather. We apologize for any inconvenience. Road conditions are poor and expected to become increasingly hazardous throughout the day. Please stay home if you are able. If you have an emergency, please call 9-1-1."
No further details were provided about when City Hall will reopen.
